'''Paul Barringer''' (born 1966/1967) is an American attorney and politician from North Carolina.<ref>{{Cite news |last=Battaglia |first=Danielle |date=October 14, 2026 |title=Challenger for NC seat says Congress has given up too much power |url=https://www.newsobserver.com/news/politics-government/election/article317339469.html |work=[[News & Observer]]}}</ref> He is the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] nominee in the 2026 election for [[North Carolina's 13th congressional district]], running against [[Brad Knott]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Zhu |first=Christine |date=2026-10-28 |title=Democrats see opening for Barringer in NC-13 race against freshman Republican Knott |url=https://ncnewsline.com/2026/10/28/democrats-see-opening-for-barringer-in-nc-13-race-against-freshman-republican-knott/ |access-date=2026-11-04 |website=[[NC Newsline]] |language=en-US}}</ref> He has a bachelor's in environmental history from [[Davidson College]], a [[Master of Public Administration]] from the [[Princeton School of Public and International Affairs]], a law degree from the [[University of North Carolina School of Law]] and a master's in health policy from [[Victoria University of Wellington]] on a [[Rotary Scholarship]].<ref>{{Cite news |last=Battaglia |first=Danielle |date=February 18, 2026 |title=See where candidates for 13th US House District disagree with their own party |url=https://www.newsobserver.com/news/politics-government/election/article314549085.html |work=[[News & Observer]]}}</ref>

Barringer is endorsed by the [[Blue Dog Coalition|Blue Dog PAC]]<ref>https://bluedogdems.com/paul-barringer/</ref> and is a signatory of the "Promise to America" pledge criticized by the Democratic Party's left for its support for capitalism and opposition to socialism.<ref>https://www.thepromisetoamerica.com/signatories/barringer</ref>
